description: Start an SAP background job (via the XBP external interface) or BW process chain, then poll until it finishes, raising with the SAP job/chain log on failure.

sap_rfc_resource_key.label: Sap Rfc Resource Key
sap_rfc_resource_key.description: Key of a registered sap_rfc_resource (provides the RFC connection).

target_type.label: Target Type
target_type.description: 'background_job': start an ABAP background job via the XBP (External Background Processing) interface. 'process_chain': start a BW process chain.

job_name.label: Job Name
job_name.description: ABAP background job name (background_job mode; required then).

job_count.label: Job Count
job_count.description: If set, start this already-scheduled job (job_name + job_count) immediately via BAPI_XBP_JOB_START_IMMEDIATE, instead of creating a new one-step job. Takes precedence over program_name/variant_name when both are set.

program_name.label: Program Name
program_name.description: ABAP program to run as the job's one step, used when job_count is unset -- a new job is opened (BAPI_XBP_JOB_OPEN), this program added as its only step (BAPI_XBP_JOB_ADD_STEP), then closed and started immediately (BAPI_XBP_JOB_CLOSE).

variant_name.label: Variant Name
variant_name.description: ABAP program variant (optional; program_name's own default variant is used when unset).

process_chain_id.label: Process Chain Id
process_chain_id.description: BW process chain technical ID (process_chain mode; required then).

xmi_interface.label: Xmi Interface
xmi_interface.description: BAPI_XMI_LOGON INTERFACE value -- the external interface this component identifies itself as.

timeout_seconds.label: Timeout Seconds
timeout_seconds.description: Max seconds to wait for the job/chain to finish before raising a timeout error.

status_field.label: Status Field
status_field.description: Field name read off the status-poll response to determine job/chain state. Defaults by target_type when unset: background_job -> 'STATUS' (BAPI_XBP_JOB_STATUS_GET's documented one-character STATUS code); process_chain -> 'E_STATUS' (RSPC_API_CHAIN_GET_STATUS's exporting parameter).

success_statuses.label: Success Statuses
success_statuses.description: status_field values (case-insensitive) treated as success. Defaults by target_type when unset: background_job -> ['F']; process_chain -> ['G','F'] (forum-sourced, not SAP-documented).

failure_statuses.label: Failure Statuses
failure_statuses.description: status_field values (case-insensitive) treated as failure. Any other value keeps polling. Defaults by target_type when unset: background_job -> ['A']; process_chain -> ['R','X','J'] (forum-sourced, not SAP-documented).

trigger_params.label: Trigger Params
trigger_params.description: Extra kwargs merged into the trigger call (e.g. job-step print parameters not covered by variant_name).

dry_run.label: Dry Run
dry_run.description: Log what would be triggered and skip opening a connection entirely -- no resource is looked up, no RFC call is made. Output metadata always includes dry_run so a materialization history shows which runs were real.

run_window.label: Run Window
run_window.description: 'HH:MM-HH:MM tz [day,day,...]' (e.g. '22:00-05:00 Europe/Berlin mon,tue,wed,thu,fri'). Outside this window, the asset SKIPS cleanly instead of triggering or failing -- no SAP job/chain is started, and real downstream dependents skip too (not fail). Checked once per materialization, before any RFC call. A malformed spec fails open (never blocks). Unset (default): always runs.

pool.label: Pool
pool.description: Dagster's native named concurrency pool (e.g. Airflow's `pool` -- a fixed number of slots shared across every asset/op using the same pool name, e.g. a cap on concurrent SAP background-job triggers). The pool's own slot count is configured at the deployment level (dagster.yaml's concurrency: pools:, or the Dagster+ UI), not here.

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.
owners.label: Owners

asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.
kinds.label: Kinds

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries

xmi_ext_company.label: Xmi Ext Company
xmi_ext_company.description: BAPI_XMI_LOGON EXTCOMPANY value -- required by the XBP interface; identifies the calling external company/organization.

xmi_ext_product.label: Xmi Ext Product
xmi_ext_product.description: BAPI_XMI_LOGON EXTPRODUCT value -- required by the XBP interface; identifies the calling external product.

external_user_name.label: External User Name
external_user_name.description: EXTERNAL_USER_NAME sent on every XBP call -- required by BAPI_XBP_JOB_OPEN / _ADD_ABAP_STEP / _CLOSE / _START_IMMEDIATELY; optional on _STATUS_GET / _JOBLOG_READ (sent there too, for consistency).

target_server.label: Target Server
target_server.description: Optional application server to run the job on (BAPI_XBP_JOB_START_IMMEDIATELY / _CLOSE's TARGET_SERVER).

job_class.label: Job Class
job_class.description: Optional ABAP job class (BAPI_XBP_JOB_OPEN's JOBCLASS, e.g. 'A'/'B'/'C').
